[package]
name = "fond-status"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "The small status file each Fond app writes for the Porog launcher — shared Fond crate"
license = "MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.80"
authors = ["Cal St Francis <calstfrancis@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/calstfrancis/fond-core"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]
